name: Vorel
description: Human/merfolk hybrid biomancer of the Simic Combine on Ravnica, former Gruul clan leader.

timeline.summary: During the War of the Spark, Vorel represents Vannifar at the guild meeting and tells Ral she had prepared for war long before Bolas.
timeline.quote: Vorel told Ral Zarek that Vannifar was a fighter and had been preparing for war long before Bolas was known to be a threat.

citation.text: "Vannifar", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gruul, Izzet and Simic forces fight together, and the group meets planeswalkers Kiora and Samut, who frees dead Eternals by name.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Gruul, Simic and Izzet storm a hill together, and Huatli, Saheeli Rai and Kasmina join; Bombop and a Simic shaman are killed.
timeline.quote: Poor Bombop rushed in too far ahead of the rest of us.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Attendees argue about surrender or hiding, and Vorel blames planeswalkers while the archer and Samut insist Bolas is never sated.
timeline.quote: There is literally nothing left of my world, Skalla, thanks to him.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Zarek reveals the plan is to resurrect the Firemind as the new Living Guildpact, surprising several guild leaders.
timeline.quote: We are here to resurrect the Firemind as the new Living Guildpact.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Guild forces and planeswalkers charge the Citadel as the Dreadhorde engages them.
timeline.quote: Those Planeswalkers not fallen—or not yet fallen—were side by side with guild warriors, engaging the silent Dreadhorde.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: The guilds assign Zarek to hunt Tezzeret, Vraska to hunt Dovin Baan, and hire Kaya to assassinate Liliana.
timeline.quote: And Kaya, the ten guilds wish to hire you to assassinate Liliana Vess.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Vorel concedes territory to the Boros and his Gruul clan turns on him; he nearly dies and escapes.
timeline.quote: the clan turned on him. He was nearly killed before escaping.

citation.text: "Vorel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorel joins the Simic and is experimented on, gaining merfolk traits.
timeline.quote: Experimented on, he received some merfolk traits.

citation.text: "Vorel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorel completes the Implicit Maze run and arrives at the Forum of Azor, where Lazav instigates chaos.
timeline.quote: He completed the run successfully and showed up at the Forum of Azor

citation.text: "Vorel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace links the maze-runners' minds, triggering the Supreme Verdict and becoming Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: which made Jace Ravnica's new Living Guildpact

citation.text: "Vorel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorel represents Vannifar at the guild meeting and tells Ral Zarek she had prepared for war.
timeline.quote: Vorel told Ral Zarek that Vannifar was a fighter

citation.text: "Vorel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorel leads the Simic into battle against the Dreadhorde.
timeline.quote: he led the Simic terraformers, super-soldiers and merfolk into the battle against the Dreadhorde
